scenes.text: If the oceans drained away tomorrow...
the seafloor would become the largest landscape on Earth.
Mountain ranges taller than the Himalayas would rise into open air.
Under the water, we have mapped less than a quarter of it.
We would be looking at a continent nobody has ever seen.
Follow What If Physics for more.
